59827-my-life-and-loves-vol-1-of-4.title: My Life And Loves
59827-my-life-and-loves-vol-1-of-4.creator: Frank Harris
59827-my-life-and-loves-vol-1-of-4.description: A book by Frank Harris. If America had not reduced me to penury I should probably not have written this book as boldly as the ideal demanded. At the last push of Fate (I am much nearer seventy than sixty) we are all apt to sacrifice something of Truth for the sake of kindly recognition by our fellows and a peaceful ending.

arxiv-2106-02450.title: Supervised learning and tree search for real-time storage allocation in Robotic Mobile Fulfillment Systems
arxiv-2106-02450.creator: Adrien Rimélé, Philippe Grangier, Michel Gamache, Michel Gendreau, Louis-Martin Rousseau
arxiv-2106-02450.description: Abstract A Robotic Mobile Fulfillment System is a robotised parts-to-picker system that is particularly well-suited for e-commerce warehousing. One distinguishing feature of this type of warehouse is its high storage modularity. Numerous robots are moving shelves simultaneously, and the shelves can be returned to any open location after the picking operation is completed.

arxiv-2108-02063.title: Air leakage in seals with application to syringes
arxiv-2108-02063.creator: N. Rodriguez, A. Tiwari, B.N.J. Persson
arxiv-2108-02063.description: Abstract We study the leakage of air in syringes with Teflon coated rubber stopper and glass barrel. The leakrate depends on the interfacial surface roughness, the viscoelastic properties of the rubber and on the elastoplastic properties of the Teflon coating.

arxiv-2109-08514.title: Proton-transfer spectroscopy beyond the normal-mode scenario
arxiv-2109-08514.creator: Florian N. Brünig, Paul Hillmann, Won Kyu Kim, Jan O. Daldrop, Roland R. Netz
arxiv-2109-08514.description: Abstract A stochastic theory is developed to predict the spectral signature of proton transfer processes and applied to infrared spectra computed from ab initio molecular-dynamics simulations of a single H 5 O 2 + {}_{2}{}^{+} cation. By constraining the oxygen atoms to a fixed distance, this system serves as a tunable model for general proton-transfer processes with variable barrier height.

arxiv-2112-07137.title: New Binary Quantum Codes Constructed from Quasi-Cyclic Codes
arxiv-2112-07137.creator: Chaofeng Guan, Ruihu Li, Liangdong Lu, Yu Yao
arxiv-2112-07137.description: Abstract It is well known that quantum codes can be constructed by means of classical symplectic dual-containing codes. This paper considers a family of two-generator quasi-cyclic codes and derives sufficient conditions for these codes to be symplectic dual-containing. Then, a new method for constructing binary quantum codes using symplectic dual-containing codes is proposed.

arxiv-2212-13782.title: Comprehensive theory of the Lamb shift in light muonic atoms Preprint: Version 1.0
arxiv-2212-13782.creator: K. Pachucki, V. Lensky, F. Hagelstein, S. S. Li Muli, S. Bacca, R. Pohl
arxiv-2212-13782.description: Abstract A comprehensive theory of the Lamb shift in light muonic atoms such as μ \mu H, μ \mu D, μ 3 \mu^{3} He + , and μ 4 \mu^{4} He + is presented, with all quantum electrodynamic corrections included at the precision level constrained by the uncertainty of nuclear structure effects.

arxiv-2301-12685.title: Distributed Matrix Computations with Low-weight Encodings This work was supported in part by the National Science Foundation (NSF) under grants CNS-2146171, CCF-1910840, and CCF-2115200, as well as by the Office of Naval Research (ONR) under grants N000142212305 and N000142112472.
arxiv-2301-12685.creator: Anindya Bijoy Das 1 , Aditya Ramamoorthy 2 , David J. Love 1 , Christopher G. Brinton 1
arxiv-2301-12685.description: Abstract Straggler nodes are well-known bottlenecks of distributed matrix computations which induce reductions in computation/communication speeds. A common strategy for mitigating such stragglers is to incorporate Reed-Solomon based MDS (maximum distance separable) codes into the framework; this can achieve resilience against an optimal number of stragglers. However, these codes assign dense linear combinations of submatrices to the worker nodes.

arxiv-2309-12883.title: On Geodesics in the Spaces of Constrained Curves
arxiv-2309-12883.creator: Esfandiar Nava-Yazdani
arxiv-2309-12883.description: Abstract In this work, we study the geodesics of the space of certain geometrically and physically motivated subspaces of the space of immersed curves endowed with a first order Sobolev metric. This includes elastic curves and also an extension of some results on planar concentric circles to surfaces. The work focuses on intrinsic and constructive approaches.

arxiv-2406-14737.title: Dissecting the Ullman Variations with a SCALPEL: Why do LLMs fail at Trivial Alterations to the False Belief Task?
arxiv-2406-14737.creator: Zhiqiang Pi (owenpi@u.northwestern.edu), Annapurna Vadaparty (avadaparty@ucsd.edu), Benjamin K. Bergen (bkbergen@ucsd.edu), Cameron R. Jones (cameron@ucsd.edu)
arxiv-2406-14737.description: Abstract Recent empirical results have sparked a debate about whether or not Large Language Models (LLMs) are capable of Theory of Mind (ToM). While some have found LLMs to be successful on ToM evaluations such as the False Belief task, others have shown that their performance is not robust against trivial alterations to stimuli.

arxiv-2503-11060.title: BannerAgency: Advertising Banner Design with Multimodal LLM Agents
arxiv-2503-11060.creator: Heng Wang, Yotaro Shimose, Shingo TakamatsuSony Group Corporation
arxiv-2503-11060.description: Abstract Advertising banners are critical for capturing user attention and enhancing advertising campaign effectiveness. Creating aesthetically pleasing banner designs while conveying the campaign messages is challenging due to the large search space involving multiple design elements. Additionally, advertisers need multiple sizes for different displays and various versions to target different sectors of audiences.

arxiv-2503-23069.title: Integral Asymptotics, Coalescing Saddles, and Multiple-scales Analysis of a Generalised Swift-Hohenberg Equation
arxiv-2503-23069.creator: Václav Klika, Mohit P. Dalwadi, Andrew L. Krause, Eamonn A. Gaffney †
arxiv-2503-23069.description: Abstract Integral asymptotics play an important role in the analysis of differential equations and in a variety of other settings. In this work, we apply an integral asymptotics approach to study spatially localized solutions of a heterogeneous generalised Swift-Hohenberg equation. The outer solution is obtained via WKBJ asymptotics, while the inner solution requires the method of coalescing saddles.

arxiv-2506-04131.title: CLAIM: An Intent-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for Analyzing Manipulation in Courtroom Dialogues
arxiv-2506-04131.creator: Disha Sheshanarayana, Tanishka Magar, Ayushi Mittal, Neelam Chaplot
arxiv-2506-04131.description: Abstract Courtrooms are places where lives are determined and fates are sealed, yet they are not impervious to manipulation. Strategic use of manipulation in legal jargon can sway the opinions of judges and affect the decisions. Despite the growing advancements in NLP, its application in detecting and analyzing manipulation within the legal domain remains largely unexplored.

arxiv-2512-06228.title: policy-based sentence simplification: replacing parallel corpora with LLM-as-a-Judge
arxiv-2512-06228.creator: Xuanxin Wu, Yuki Arase, Masaaki Nagata
arxiv-2512-06228.description: Abstract Sentence simplification aims to modify a sentence to make it easier to read and understand while preserving the meaning. Different applications require distinct simplification policies, such as replacing only complex words at the lexical level or rewriting the entire sentence while trading off details for simplicity. However, achieving such policy-driven control remains an open challenge.

arxiv-2602-23863.title: NAU-QMUL: Utilizing BERT and CLIP for Multi-modal AI-Generated Image Detection
arxiv-2602-23863.creator: Xiaoyu Guo, Arkaitz Zubiaga
arxiv-2602-23863.description: Abstract With the aim of detecting AI-generated images and identifying the specific models responsible for their generation, we propose a multi-modal multi-task model. The model leverages pre-trained BERT and CLIP Vision encoders for text and image feature extraction, respectively, and employs cross-modal feature fusion with a tailored multi-task loss function.

europmc-pmc6969442.title: The progress of gut microbiome research related to brain disorders.
europmc-pmc6969442.creator: Zhu S, Jiang Y, Xu K, Cui M, Ye W, Zhao G, Jin L, Chen X.
europmc-pmc6969442.description: There is increasing evidence showing that the dynamic changes in the gut microbiota can alter brain physiology and behavior. Cognition was originally thought to be regulated only by the central nervous system. However, it is now becoming clear that many non-nervous system...

pmc-10714532.title: Castleman disease of plasma cell type accompanied with bronchiolitis obliterans: a case report and review of the literature
pmc-10714532.creator: Qingyuan Zhu, Shuiyou Wang
pmc-10714532.description: BackgroundCastleman disease, also known as giant lymph node hyperplasia or angiofollicular lymph node hyperplasia, is a highly heterogeneous clinicopathological entity that belongs to the family lymphoproliferative disorders. Castleman disease accompanied by bronchiolitis obliterans is uncommon and often poses a great diagnostic challenge, which is easily confused with respiratory diseases and impeding the correct diagnosis and treatment.

pmc-10739450.title: THE IMPACT OF INFORMAL CARE ON FORMAL CARE UTILIZATION AMONG ELDERLY AMERICANS
pmc-10739450.creator: Yemiao Ke, Yun Zhang
pmc-10739450.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectivesThis research aims (1) to examines the impact of informal care on the utilization of formal care among elderly Americans, and (2) to investigate how probable dementia affect this relationship.MethodUsing cross-sectional data from the National Health and Aging Trends Study (NHATS 2011 & 2015), we build a correlated Tobit model to analyze the quantity of informal and formal care received by elderly individuals, which not only handles the censored nature of the dependent variables, but also allows a more flexible error structure.

pmc-10754118.title: Lipophilic Nucleoside Triphosphate Prodrugs of Anti‐HIV Active Nucleoside Analogs as Potential Antiviral Compounds
pmc-10754118.creator: Xiao Jia, Dominique Schols, Chris Meier
pmc-10754118.description: Nucleoside analogs require three phosphorylation steps catalyzed by cellular kinases to give their triphosphorylated metabolites. Herein, the synthesis of two types of triphosphate prodrugs of different nucleoside analogs is disclosed. Triphosphates comprising: i) a γ‐phosphate or γ‐phosphonate bearing a bioreversible acyloxybenzyl group and a long alkyl group and ii) γ‐dialkyl phosphate/phosphonate modified nucleoside triphosphate analogs.

pmc-11696833.title: Cyclic Olefin Copolymer-Based Fixed-Target Sample Delivery Device for Protein X-ray Crystallography
pmc-11696833.creator: Abhik Manna, Mukul Sonker, Domin Koh, Michael Steiger, Adil Ansari, Hao Hu, Isabel Quereda-Moraleda, Alice Grieco, Diandra Doppler, Daniele de Sanctis, Shibom Basu, Julien Orlans, Samuel L Rose, Sabine Botha, Jose Manuel Martin-Garcia, Alexandra Ros
pmc-11696833.description: Serial macromolecular X-ray crystallography plays an important role in elucidating protein structures and consequently progressing the field of targeted therapeutics. The use of pulsed beams at different repetition frequencies requires the development of various sample-conserving injection strategies to minimize sample wastage between X-ray exposures.

pmc-12594824.title: Exploring the inhibition mechanisms of momordin Ic on S. aureus serine/threonine phosphatase (Stp1) using theoretical and experimental approaches
pmc-12594824.creator: Yanan Yang, Xuenan Li, Pingping Hou, Na Wei
pmc-12594824.description: Serine/threonine phosphatase (Stp1) modulates the expression of Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) by regulating cysteine phosphorylation. Therefore, Stp1 is a promising target for inhibiting S. aureus infection. In this study, the natural compound momordin Ic was found to have significant inhibitory activity against Stp1 through virtual screening and phosphatase assays.

pmc-12802129.title: When to vaccinate for seasonal influenza: check the peak forecast
pmc-12802129.creator: Julie A. Spencer, Manhong Z. Smith, Dave Osthus, Prescott C. Alexander, Sara Y. Del Valle
pmc-12802129.description: BackgroundSeasonal influenza infects 5-20% of people every year in the United States, resulting in hospitalizations, deaths, and adverse economic impacts. To mitigate these impacts, influenza vaccines are developed and distributed annually; however, growing evidence suggests that vaccine effectiveness (VE) wanes over the course of a flu season.

pmc-13373011.title: Dopaminergic Drugs Modulate Resting-State EEG Microstates in Healthy Participants
pmc-13373011.creator: Renate de Bock, Amatya J Mackintosh, Alexandra Korda, Alina Preuss, Daniel J Hauke, Andreea O Diaconescu, Philipp Sterzer, Stefan Borgwardt, Christina Andreou
pmc-13373011.description: Changes in the temporal parameters of EEG microstates are observed in various psychiatric illnesses, including psychotic disorders. These changes have also been observed in individuals with a clinical or genetic high risk for psychosis. It is unclear whether dopamine abnormalities, distinctive of psychotic disorders, contribute to microstate alterations.

pmc-13413496.title: Taxonomic study of Tulasnella species focusing on their teleomorphs: Descriptions of a new species and two newly recorded species in Japan
pmc-13413496.creator: Kosuke Nagamune, Nitaro Maekawa, Kenta Fujii, Naoki Endo, Akira Nakagiri, Kenji Suetsugu, Dai Nagamatsu
pmc-13413496.description: The genus Tulasnella is generally regarded as saprotrophic, but several species are known to form mycorrhizal associations. Basidioma morphology is a crucial taxonomic character in Tulasnella; however, recent studies have focused on DNA sequences of cultured mycelia isolated from orchid roots for species delimitation and description.

pmc-13454871.title: Malondialdehyde–Superoxide Dismutase Redox Imbalance as an Early Biological Risk Indicator in Young Adult Smokers
pmc-13454871.creator: Kumboyono Kumboyono, Indah Nur Chomsy, Titin Andri Wihastuti
pmc-13454871.description: PurposeYoung adult smokers represent a population in which smoking-related health risks may accumulate silently before the onset of clinically apparent disease. Although smoking-related changes in malondialdehyde (MDA) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) have been widely reported, less is known about their combined oxidant–antioxidant pattern in apparently healthy young adults during the early smoking trajectory.

pmc-13570988.title: The Moderating Role of Online Privacy Awareness in the Relationship Between Smartphone Addiction and Online Grooming Risk in Adolescents
pmc-13570988.creator: Erdal Görkem Gavcar, Ahmet Büber, Bürge Kabukçu Başay, Ömer Başay, Merve Aktaş Terzioğlu
pmc-13570988.description: Adolescents’ increasing dependence on smartphones has heightened concerns about vulnerability to online risks, including online grooming risk. However, the processes linking smartphone addiction to online grooming risk, and the roles of online privacy awareness and phubbing behavior (ignoring others in face-to-face interactions due to smartphone use), remain insufficiently understood, especially in clinical populations.

uslaw-usc-t49-s47115.title: 49 U.S.C. § 47115 — Discretionary fund
uslaw-usc-t49-s47115.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s47115.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part B (Airport Development And Noise); Chapter 471 (Airport Development); Subchapter I (Airport Improvement). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Existence and Amounts in Fund.— The Secretary of Transportation has a discretionary fund. The fund consists of— (1) amounts subject to apportionment for a fiscal year that are not apportioned under section 47114(c)–(e) of this title.
